_: The pay phone's directory (src/phone.js). book: what the phone book lists. numbers: digits (7 or 10) to an outcome: kind time | machine | recording | intercept | busy; file is a recording in assets/audio/ when there is one, otherwise the transcript carries it; requires names an item (or a list, any of them) the caller must have found (src/items.js) or the call gets its locked intercept; opens gives an item's own sound and line when it opens the call; ring picks the ringback (us | eu | uk). area: the local area code, so seven digits dial a listed number. exchange: the listed exchange; an unlisted number in it is not in service, one in any other exchange cannot be completed as dialed. intercepts: the phone company's lines, Jane Barbe's when the files arrive (a file that is not there yet falls back to the transcript).

4065550199.name: the bench
4065550199.note: The pay phone's own line, and you are standing on it. When another visitor is in the scene it should ring their booth instead (README).
4065550199.text: Busy. It is this phone's own number, and you are standing on the line.

4065550123.name: the phone company
4065550123.note: Her takes, 1973 to 1985: the time, the intercepts, the coin prompts, and at the end her own voice, off the clock.
4065550123.missing: The line crackles. Nobody has put the recording in yet.

0113615550160.name: budapest
0113615550160.greeting: Halló? ... Tessék? ... (someone, somewhere far away, talking at length in Hungarian)

whistle.text: The whistle, into the mouthpiece. Something far away clicks over.

4067210000.name: home
4067210000.note: An old listing. The exchange is gone.

cannot.text: I'm sorry, your call cannot be completed as dialed. Please hang up and check the number and dial again, or ask information operator for assistance. This is a recording.

service.text: I'm sorry, the number you have reached is not in service at this time. If you need assistance, please hang up and dial your directory assistance operator. This is a recording.

directory.text: Directory assistance is not available from this telephone.

operator.text: There is no operator on this line.

international.text: We're sorry, international calls cannot be placed from this telephone without assistance.

credits.barbe: The intercepts and the phone company's number are Jane Barbe, from Telephone World's collection (telephoneworld.org), cut from their compilation; the whistle is a Cap'n Crunch Bo'sun whistle recorded for a comparison video.
